basePoints.note: User-reported from 100-REV6 screenshots (not re-examined in this pass) and stated by five community sources; allthings-difficulty quotes the screen text "Available Perk Points: 3".

firstRunLocksPerks.note: allthings-difficulty quotes the screen text "Starting Perks are not available on your first run". Community sources say the Starting Perks panel is unavailable on the first run. No source lists perks that are only locked for first runs.

everyPerkUsesSlot.note: Negative and zero-cost perks also occupy a slot (nicokobo-starting-perks agrees); Colorful Character occupies one of its own slots.

validatedAtContinue.note: User report (100-REV6) plus nicokobo-starting-perks: "selection may temporarily exceed a limit, but Continue validates it". The game does not auto-remove perks, so neither does this app.

exclusions.note: wiki-gunsmith confirms the full scavenge block and alternative scavenge perks are exclusive (no names given).

startRules.text: Start flow: specialization -> Starting Perks -> Difficulty and options.
First run: Starting Perks are not available ("Starting Perks are not available on your first run").
First run: choosing a specialization other than Apprentice shows a confirmation prompt, then you can continue.
First run: ticking Skip Intro shows a confirmation prompt.
Fence, Rock Bottom, Gunsmith and Chemist always skip the intro (Skip Intro is forced on).
No source documents a difficulty restriction on the first run; all four difficulties appear selectable.
Difficulty screen option: Endless Mode (checkbox; tooltip "Certain scripted events and customers will not spawn").

dumpingGroundSearches.note: From the Degenerative Osteoarthritis text ("Normal shopkeepers start with 5 daily max attempts").
